description: Integration matrix mapping each agentic RAG component to the platform systems it interfaces with

planner.description: Planner uses learner snapshot for personalization, memory for context, KB for curriculum awareness

query_rewriter.description: Query rewriter dispatches to retrieval sources including curriculum KB

search_fanout.description: Fanout routes queries to curriculum, memory, learner profile, and recommendations

evidence_graph.description: Evidence graph persists evidence and supports analytics queries

sufficient_context.description: Context agent evaluates evidence coverage and decides whether to continue retrieval

tutor.description: Tutor generates responses with recommendations, tracks progress, awards XP, triggers diagrams, and feeds assessments
